checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, wargames/, references/, examples/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

notes: Twelve of twenty-four cited rows carry a definite licence, two record that the source states none, and ten are unconfirmed. Three clusters: ACM proceedings read through author copies (EV-0313, EV-0316), vendor and practitioner pages with no licence statement (EV-0240, EV-0307, EV-0311), and five one-offs (EV-0041, EV-0059, EV-0309, EV-0312, EV-0320). EV-0313 and EV-0316 sit behind binding requirements B4 and B5, so they are the two worth confirming first. Two rows carry recorded reuse restrictions rather than unknowns: EV-0306 is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and EV-0308 and EV-0319 are all rights reserved with paraphrase only; the prose citing all three is ours. This pass also removed the backticks this pack had around its EV ids, which were left over from the fragment-id rewrite and made the citations read as code. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
